records.question_text: When a proposed line of research seems unreachable, does a separately controllable dependency or interface change the missing precondition?
inclusion_criteria: The case documents a blocked or seemingly unreachable prerequisite
A second dependency, input, or interface is investigated for evidence that changes reachability
The proposed connection concerns reachability, not the vulnerability class
exclusion_criteria: The second feature is only used after access is already established
The difficulty is purely lack of interesting hypotheses, not a missing access precondition
A similar-looking exploit or tool is the only link
records.boundary_or_invariant: Reachability of a research prerequisite without assuming it is already satisfied
records.contrast_example: ShadowPanel's scan identifier and .MOBI's legacy WHOIS-server control are different capabilities; similarity is not evidence they test one core question.

provenance.notes: Analyst comparison hypothesis. Not proven recurrence, reviewed equivalence, or prior-art novelty.

evidence_anchors.locator: sections: Setting The Scene; Collateral Damage In Pursuit Of RCE

records.notes: No curator review. Unclassified questions must remain allowed; falsifying contrast examples should be sought before promotion.

records.question_text: Can an apparent security signal be explained by the measuring instrument or the test procedure instead of the system under test?
inclusion_criteria: A recorded signal initially favors a defect hypothesis
A later independent check distinguishes target behavior from an artifact of the test
exclusion_criteria: Merely slow or expensive tests that never suggested a false signal
True vulnerability signals with no disputed measurement
records.contrast_example: Choosing a cheap feasibility experiment is not the same as an instrument-generated false positive.
